_readme: Settings for the hello smoke test. Push a change to the board with:
Every app in this repo reads apps/<app>/data/config.json. Every key is
optional -- delete this whole file and hello still runs on its compiled
defaults. Secrets (Wi-Fi PSK, API keys) never go in here; they live in
lib/board/secrets.h, which is gitignored and compiled in. config.json sits
on a filesystem anyone holding the board can dump. See SECURITY.md.
brightness  backlight duty, 8-255. Deliberately high here: this screen
exists to check pixels, not to be looked at.
tickMs      ms between LED colour changes and button samples, 50-5000.
